title: Revert "Chart gitsync vars (#56245)"
body:
This reverts commit d0da0c02046260a652ca4506a29fa454f197f261.

Reverts #56245, as we can't safely use the tag to determine the version. Since we will be dropping support for 3 in the next release anyways, we will just keep it as-is for 1 more release.


Alternative of #61027
